title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager

São Paulo – São Paulo – Brazil – Hybrid (Vila Olimpía)

Who We Are

Intrials is a disruptive company with all the attributes that a CRO must master. We mix innovative projects with the necessary skills to provide a full service. Nothing stops us in the search for knowledge. Transforming people's lives through science when it comes to solving the challenges of our clients' projects in a focused and exclusive fashion.

Diversity & Inclusion are essential to continue building our history of innovation. Diversity of color, belief, sexual orientation, religion, or any other characteristic are very welcome in all open positions at our company. It is a fundamental part of Intrials to constantly think and implement actions that reinforce the importance of good coexistence with all the people who are part of our DNA and together, to leverage and build true impactful results in our society.

Basic Functions and Responsibilities includes, but are not limited to :

▪ Clinical Study Management: Manage clinical studies from study planning and set-up to study closure, following contract requirements.

▪ Budget and Timeline Management: Ownership and Oversight of the the budgets and timelines specified in the clinical study contract.

▪ Oversight of Functions: Provide oversight of other functions, including Clinical, Safety, Regulatory & Start-up, and Vendor Management.

▪ Business Development: Contribute to business development in the preparation of proposals (BIDs), and portfolio management activities.

▪ Customer Relationship: Act as the Intrials representative and primary point of contact with the Sponsor for the clinical study. Take ownership of the customer relationship throughout the project and drive the resolution of customer issues.

▪ Compliance: Ensure that study activities are conducted in compliance with Intrials quality standards, Intrials and/or Sponsor’s SOPs, GCP-ICH guidelines, and local and international regulations.

▪ Protocol and Training: Maintain an in-depth knowledge of the protocol, therapeutic area, and indication. Participate in study-related training to the Intrials clinical operations team involved in the study, offering regular support on various aspects such as protocol, monitoring plan, recruitment plan, CRF, monitoring tools, and study systems.

▪ Project Planning: Develop and review operational project plans in collaboration with the clinical study team. This includes Monitoring Plans, Communication Plans, Project Management Plans, Risk Management Plans, and others. Ensure that the study is executed in accordance with all established plans.

▪ Monitoring Quality: Ensure the overall quality of monitoring activities Identify and escalate significant issues reported by Clinical Research Associates (CRAs) and Clinical Trial Manager (CTM) to the Sponsor, and follows up until issue is resolved.

▪ Supplies and Materials: Take proper measures to ensure the adequate provisioning of supplies, devices, and materials required for the study, adhering to study specifications.

▪ Collaboration: Collaborate with other departments within the company to support milestone achievement and effectively manage study-related issues and obstacles.

▪ Advanced Risk Management: Identify, assess and develop mitigation strategies for risks in studies, together with the quality Department of Intrials

▪ Strategic Leadership: Lead the formulation and review of processes in collaboration with leaders from other functions, demonstrating leadership and strategic decision-making skills.

▪ Business Development: Actively participate in business proposals and portfolio development activities, including identifying new business opportunities and expanding relationships with existing sponsors.

▪ Complex Problem Solving: Managing and resolving study or client issues, requiring negotiation and conflict resolution skills.

▪ Additional Duties: The Project Manager may be assigned other duties to ensure completion of company objectives.

Primary Activities includes, but are not limited to:

▪ Regular communication with Sponsor in order to support the definition of the study design and the best strategy for project implementation in the countries covered by Intrials operations;

▪ Regular contact with other departments within the company to support milestone achievement and to manage study issues and obstacles;

▪ Establish an enthusiastic work environment and a motivated project team, encouraging open communication and ensuring high-quality work;

▪ Manage the feasibility process, supporting the approach, identification, and selection of sites to clinical study;

▪ Develop integrated study management plans with the core project team;

▪ Keep close contact with Sponsors / Investigators; ▪ Co-organize / conduct / participate in investigators meetings / other project related meetings (face-to-face or teleconference) according to Sponsor alignment;

▪ Organize / conduct meetings with Intrials study team at regular basis/whenever needed;

▪ Organize / conduct meetings with the Sponsor according to study project and Sponsor’s request;

▪ Provide support to CRAs, CTM and team at regular basis (protocol, monitoring plan, recruitment plan, CRF, monitoring tools, study systems, etc.);

▪ Assume and support monitoring activities whenever necessary;

▪ Oversee daily activities of operational team to ensure focus on quality and timelines;

▪ Ensure high quality level in data collection and queries resolution;

▪ Coordinate study activities with CRAs and CTM, including pre-selection visits, initiation visits, CRA training, recruitment, interim monitoring visits and close-out activities;

▪ Ensure study is conducted in compliance with all study plans;

▪ Ensure adequate provisioning of supplies, devices, and materials in the study, according to study requirements;

▪ Prepare / review study status tools (newsletters, recruitment status, periodic report, etc.) whenever needed or requested by the Sponsor;

▪ Identify and record non-conformity and provide preventive actions supported by Intrials QA department;

▪ Track study metrics and milestones to guarantee that the project is being conducted according to Sponsor’s requirements;

▪ Prepare / support contract and negotiate budget with study sites;

▪ Ensure study documentation is properly maintained and archived in eTMF / TMF and databases, as applicable;

▪ Ensure overall monitoring quality by reviewing and evaluating monitoring visits reports, detecting issues, resolving and/or escalating issues reported by CRAs;

▪ Manage risks and contingencies proactively and lead problem solving and resolution efforts;

▪ Mitigate risks with action plans in place as agreed with upper management and / or the Sponsor; ▪ Provide support to on-site audits and inspections;

▪ Review SOPs related to the department activities;

▪ Attend courses / meetings in order to improve / acquire new skills;

▪ Share lessons learned with the team and ensure adequate deployment of possible identified action plans;

▪ Prepare revenue reports own projects and revenue forecast.

Skills:

▪ University Degree (preferably in the health science area such as Pharmacy, Biology, Biomedicine, Nursing, Medicine, other);

▪ In depth understanding of Clinical Research industry (drug/device/technology/etc.) and the relevant environments in which it operates;

▪ Reliable and demonstrable professional experience;

▪ Good organizational, communication and interpersonal relationships;

▪ In-depth knowledge of ICH-GCP, national and international regulations;

▪ Training/presentation skills

▪ Fluency in English;

▪ Basic Spanish is highly recommended;

▪ Computer skills on Windows and Microsoft Office tools.

title: Staff Data Engineer
description:
Sobre a vaga:

O Candidato de Staff Data Engineer, ficará alocado(a) no Banco John Deere, você será responsável por atuar como liderança técnica da plataforma de dados, definindo arquitetura, padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de dados que garantam escala, governança, confiabilidade e sustentabilidade das soluções de dados. Você atuará de forma transversal, apoiando múltiplos times e produtos, sendo referência técnica em decisões estratégicas de dados, trabalhando em parceria com Engineering Managers, Product Managers e áreas de negócio. Esta é uma posição Individual Contributor, com forte impacto organizacional e foco em longo prazo.

As responsabilidades de Staff Data Engineer incluem:

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura da plataforma de dados, incluindo ingestão, transformação, armazenamento e consumo;
  • Estabelecer padrões técnicos e boas práticas de engenharia de dados para uso por múltiplos times;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para engenheiros de dados, apoiando decisões arquiteturais e promovendo mentoria;
  • Conduzir decisões técnicas relacionadas a escalabilidade, custo, governança, qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados;
  • Trabalhar de forma próxima a Engineering Managers e Product Managers para alinhar soluções de dados às necessidades do negócio e requisitos regulatórios;
  • Resolver problemas técnicos complexos e sistêmicos que impactam múltiplos pipelines, domínios ou produtos de dados;
  • Contribuir para a evolução contínua da estratégia de dados do Banco John Deere.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa ou equivalente em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima em progressiva em engenharia de dados, com trajetória consistente;
  • Experiência comprovada em mentoria e liderança técnica de outros engenheiros;
  • Atuar como autoridade técnica na resolução de problemas complexos de engenharia de dados;
  • Conhecimento de Arquitetura e Plataforma de Dados;
  • Experiência com Engenharia e Processamento de Dados (ingestão, transformação, orquestração, processamento em larga escala);
  • Conhecimento em Governança, Qualidade, Lineage, Segurança e Conformidade de Dados;
  • Domínio avançado de Cloud e Infraestrutura para Dados (plataformas em cloud, otimização de custos, resiliência operacional);
  • Domínio avançado de AWS (Amazon Web Services), com foco em S3 (Simple Storage Service) e Data Lake;
  • Experiência com AWS DMS (Data Migration Service);
  • Experiência com Databricks e Apache Spark;
  • Conhecimento de SQL (Structured Query Language) avançado e Bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, AWS);
  • Experiência com Modelagem e transformação de dados para consumo analítico;
  • Conhecimento em Escalabilidade e estratégias de entrega de dados (batch, streaming, near real-time);

O Que Faz Você se Destacar:

  • Ter definido padrões ou arquiteturas de dados utilizados por mais de um time ou produto;
  • Experiência com governança de dados, incluindo qualidade, lineage, versionamento e auditoria;
  • Histórico de decisões técnicas que impactaram custo, escalabilidade ou confiabilidade da plataforma de dados;
  • Vivência em ambientes regulados (financeiro, crédito, risco, compliance ou similares);
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em soluções de dados simples, escaláveis e sustentáveis.

title: Travel Designer
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Travel Designer to plan and execute highly curated itineraries for a sophisticated and growing global clientele.

This is a client-facing role focused on delivering seamless, personalized service. You will collaborate closely with internal teams and trusted global partners to ensure every trip reflects the highest standards of luxury and service.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career! Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a Data Scientist with a strong focus on Generative AI, capable of designing, developing, and evolving solutions based on LLMs, intelligent agents, and cognitive automations. This professional will work in the creation of agent architecture, integration with corporate data, construction of automated service and decision support flows, in addition to the continuous experimentation of generative models applied to real business problems.

The role requires a combination of data science, applied engineering, prompt engineering, RAG, and agent orchestration, with practical insight into how to scale GenAI solutions in a secure, governed, and measurable way.

Responsibilities

§ Design and implement Generative AI solutions based on LLMs for customer service, operational support, and process automation.

§ Develop and orchestrate AI agents (single-agent and multi-agent), with decision-making, planning, and task execution capabilities.

§ Build RAGE (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines by integrating LLMs into structured and unstructured foundations.

§ Develop and optimize prompts, chunking strategies, embeddings, and semantic retrieval.

§ Integrate agents and generative models with automation workflows, APIs, legacy systems, and fulfillment platforms.

§ Evaluate quality, safety, and performance of GenAI solutions (hallucination, groundedness, latency, cost).

§ Apply statistical and machine learning concepts for evaluation, experimentation, and continuous improvement of solutions.

§ Work together with data, engineering, product, UX, and business teams to evolve solutions.

§ Support the definition of standards, good practices, and governance for the use of Generative AI in a corporate environment.

Hard Skills

§ Solid experience with Generative AI and LLMs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or equivalent).

§ Development of AI agents and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel or similar).

§ Hands-on experience with RAG, embeddings, vectors, and vector bases.

§ Strong Python domain and integration via APIs.

§ Knowledge in Machine Learning and fundamentals of applied statistics.

§ Experience with intelligent automations and integration with corporate systems.

§ Knowledge of cloud architecture (Azure, AWS or GCP).

§ Notions of MLOps / LLMOps (versioning, monitoring, evaluation and costs).

Soft Skills

§ Experimental and innovation-oriented mindset.

§ Ability to transform business problems into solutions with agents and GenAI.

§ Clear communication with technical and executive stakeholders.

§ Autonomy, sense of ownership and continuous learning.

§ Collaboration in multidisciplinary teams.

Differentials

§ Experience with corporate copilots, advanced chatbots, and virtual assistants.

§ Experience in customer service automation or Backoffice projects with AI.

§ Knowledge in AI governance, security, and ethics.

§ Experience with advanced LLM evaluation (A/B testing, human feedback, custom metrics).

§ Previous experience in regulated environments (banking, insurance, health, energy).

title: Supervisor de Enfermagem - Unidade de Internação Pediátrica Oncológica
description:
Requisitos:

- Superior completo em Enfermagem;

-Pós graduação em área assistencial;

-COREN ativo e dentro da validade;

-Necessário boa vivência com gestão de equipes, experiência na área assistencial, com oncologia pediátrica.

Atividades:

- Tomar ciência, diariamente, das orientações constantes do livro de Ordens e Ocorrências e demais anotações, a fim de tomar ciência das intercorrências ocorridas no plantão diurno possibilitando dar continuidade aos tratamentos dos pacientes;

- Com base na escala mensal de funcionários, recebida da Gerência de Enfermagem, conferir diariamente a presença, atrasos, licença médicas e trocas de plantão realizado pelos funcionários, anotando no livro de ordens e ocorrência as divergências encontradas;

- Inspecionar, diariamente, os Setores de Enfermagem da Unidade, avaliando a qualidade de assistência prestada e identificando a necessidade de utilização de equipamentos e remanejamento de pessoal para prestação de atendimento adequado, bem como se as equipes estão utilizando o uniforme padrão da Unidade, com seus respectivos equipamentos de segurança;

- Orientar as atividades desenvolvidas pelos Enfermeiros Plantonistas, na realização de suas atividades diárias, bem como observando e orientando aspectos de desvio de comportamentos, a fim de corrigir os problemas com colaboradores no seu turno;

- Atender os clientes e seus acompanhantes, quando solicitado, esclarecendo as dúvidas apresentadas, bem como providenciando a solução aos superiores de plantão, caso o assunto fuja dos limites de sua autonomia;

- Garantir o cumprimento das Instruções Operacionais Técnicas e Administrativas do serviço noturno como: preparo pré-operatório, pré-exames, transferência de pacientes, conferência de material/medicação, requisição de farmácia, registrando as intercorrências e dificuldades encontradas no plantão no livro de Ordens e Ocorrências;

- Apoiar a Recepção de Internação propondo e encaminhando soluções inerentes a liberação de quarto ou leito, a fim de facilitar o processo de internação de novos ou transferências internas de pacientes;

- Acionar, quando necessário, o Setor de Engenharia Clínica, visando providenciar o reparo de equipamentos defeituosos na Unidade, durante seu plantão;

- Acompanhar e orientar situações de acidentes de trabalho ocorridos no seu turno, encaminhando os acidentados ao Setor de Emergência, bem como comunicando ao Setor de Medicina e Segurança do Trabalho as ocorrências;

- Intermediar situações que necessitem de auxílio a outras Unidades da Rede, obtendo autorização superior para os casos de: empréstimo de materiais e equipamentos médico-hospitalares, uso de autoclave e etc;

- Participar da elaboração de manuais de rotinas ou POPs, junto com as áreas de CCIH, Qualidade e Educação Continuada, a fim de contribuir para a implantação de processo de melhores práticas de assistência hospitalar;

- Testar materiais e equipamentos novos e responder pareceres técnicos enviados pelos setores de padronização e engenharia clínica respectivamente para análise e decisão sobre a utilização/aquisição.

Outras informações:

Barra da Tijuca - RJ.

- Escala de trabalho:

200h - 07h às 16h.

- Disponibilidade para treinamento.

title: Business Analyst
description:
A Oportunidade

A MyCareforce/Clicknurse está em um momento acelerado de crescimento, conectando profissionais de saúde a oportunidades de trabalho no Brasil e em Portugal. Já cobrimos +1.200.000 horas de enfermagem conectando +21.000 profissionais a +300 unidades de saúde. Somos uma empresa de tecnologia em crescimento (+€3.3M investimento) com uma missão clara: melhorar a qualidade dos cuidados de saúde.

Estamos buscando um Business Analyst com forte viés analítico para se juntar ao nosso time no Brasil.

Estamos procurando alguém com a mentalidade de um consultor estratégico – alguém que não apenas manuseie dados, mas que consiga mergulhar neles para extrair insights que direcionarão o sucesso dos nossos clientes (hospitais e unidades de saúde) e o crescimento do nosso negócio. Se você tem ~2 anos de experiência, preferencialmente em consultoria, uma capacidade analítica acima da média e fome de impactar um negócio em escala, essa vaga é para você.

Sobre a Função

Você reportará diretamente ao Head of Strategy & Planning , tendo alta exposição à liderança da empresa. Seu papel principal será atuar como o "motor de inteligência" da área, analisando dados internos e de mercado de ambas as geografias (BR e PT) para identificar onde podemos gerar mais valor.

Inicialmente, o foco será na geração de inteligência estratégica (back-office) para municiar os times internos - Operações e Comercial. No entanto, existe um caminho claro de evolução: à medida que você demonstrar senioridade e domínio do negócio, passará a ter exposição direta a clientes, participando de reuniões com executivos para apresentar suas análises.

Esta é uma posição com alto potencial de crescimento, podendo evoluir a médio prazo para uma posição de Gerência de BizOps, à medida que a nossa abordagem consultiva se torna cada vez mais central para o sucesso do cliente.

O Que Você Fará

  • Deep Dive Analítico: Realizar análises profundas e recorrentes dos dados operacionais dos nossos clientes para entender padrões de comportamento, gargalos e tendências de utilização da plataforma.
  • Geração de Insights Acionáveis: Ir além dos números para identificar proativamente oportunidades de negócio: como podemos aumentar o "share of wallet" nos clientes atuais? Onde estão as oportunidades de melhoria nos nossos serviços? Quais são as necessidades não atendidas dos clientes?
  • Inteligência de Mercado: Buscar, compilar e analisar dados externos de mercado (Brasil e Portugal) para complementar as análises internas e trazer benchmarks relevantes.
  • Comunicação Execuiva: Traduzir análises complexas em relatórios e apresentações executivas (Google Slides/PPT) que sejam claras, "insightful" e que contem uma história convincente para embasar decisões estratégicas.
  • Suporte Estratégico: Atuar como braço direito analítico do Head of Strategy & Planning, fornecendo dados rápidos e precisos para a tomada de decisão em um ambiente de prioridades dinâmicas.

Quem Você É

  • Experiência: Você possui mais de 1 ano de experiência profissional efetiva, preferencialmente em consultorias de gestão/estratégicas, ou em áreas de inteligência de negócios/BizOps em startups de alto crescimento.
  • Hard Skills Essenciais:
  • Domínio sólido de Google Sheets/Excel (você será testado nisso).
  • Conhecimento prático em SQL para extração e manipulação de dados.
  • Excelente capacidade de escrita e criação de apresentações estruturadas.
  • Mentalidade Analítica: Você é movido por dados e tem uma curiosidade intelectual aguçada para entender o "porquê" por trás dos números.
  • Perfil Comportamental: Você possui alta disposição para trabalhar em um ambiente de demanda intensa, com prioridades que mudam rapidamente. Você é autônomo, resiliente e tem senso de urgência.
  • Diferencial: Experiência prévia ou conhecimento do mercado de saúde (BR ou PT) será considerado uma vantagem.

O Que Oferecemos

  • Contratação modelo PJ com remuneração competitiva.
  • Possibilidade de Stock Options (equity) atreladas à performance.
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido na Vila Olímpia - São Paulo (3 dias presenciais, 2 remotos).
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, com autonomia e exposição direta à liderança sênior.
  • Oportunidade real de crescimento acelerado e evolução de carreira (ex: trilha para Gerência de Estratégia e Operações).

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Technical Account Manager – Telecom Software

Iquall es una compañía de software especializada en automatización y transformación de redes para operadores de telecomunicaciones. Trabajamos con grandes carriers, ayudándolos a modernizar su operación, automatizar procesos críticos y evolucionar la gestión de la red hacia modelos más eficientes y autónomos. Somos una empresa con fuerte ADN técnico, pero con visión comercial y foco en crecimiento sostenible. Nuestro modelo combina coherencia comercial, credibilidad técnica y ejecución sólida.

Buscamos un Technical Account Manager (TAM) con fuerte perfil estratégico y orientación al cliente para gestionar cuentas clave (Tier-1) dentro del sector telecom. El TAM es responsable de gestionar integralmente la cuenta desde lo técnico-comercial. No es un rol de soporte ni de delivery operativo. Es quien entiende los desafíos del cliente, influye en su planificación futura y construye oportunidades sostenibles. El rol combina visión técnica, desarrollo de negocio y acompañamiento post-venta para asegurar la generación de valor continuo y la adopción de nuestras soluciones de automatización.

Principales Responsabilidades

Gestión Estratégica y Desarrollo de Negocio:

  • Comprender la estructura tecnológica, operativa y presupuestaria del cliente, alineando nuestras soluciones con sus iniciativas de transformación digital y eficiencia operativa.
  • Detectar iniciativas y problemas estructurales antes de que se conviertan en procesos formales de licitación (RFPs).
  • Generar proactivamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling sobre la base instalada ("budget fishing").
  • Influir en la planificación futura y las líneas presupuestarias del cliente.

Venta Consultiva (Soluciones Estándar):

  • Diseñar y presentar de forma autónoma propuestas técnico-comerciales cuando la solución se base en el portafolio existente de Iquall.
  • Traducir capacidades complejas de producto en soluciones claras, viables y con sentido económico para el cliente.

Relacionamiento y Evangelización:

  • Construir vínculos sólidos y gestionar múltiples stakeholders dentro de organizaciones complejas, manteniendo credibilidad tanto frente a equipos de ingeniería/operativos como áreas ejecutivas (C-Level).
  • Orquestar workshops y sesiones ejecutivas ("Overview Demos") para mostrar el arte de lo posible e impulsar la adopción de nuevas funcionalidades.
  • Continuidad Post-Venta (Value Delivery):
  • Asegurar la correcta implementación y adopción de las soluciones vendidas.
  • Coordinar la transición hacia la ejecución junto a los Project Managers (PMs) y Delivery, identificando riesgos tempranos, pero sin gestionar la operación directamente.

Requisitos Excluyentes:

  • Experiencia: 5+ años en roles de gestión técnica de cuentas, consultoría técnica o ingeniería de ventas (Pre-Sales) con fuerte componente relacional y orientados a resultados comerciales.
  • Industria: Experiencia sólida trabajando con operadores de telecomunicaciones (Tier-1 preferentemente), conocimiento de operaciones, arquitectura de red (fija, móvi, Cloudl, ej. FTTH, 4G/5G), y plataformas OSS/BSS.
  • Formación: Título universitario en Ingeniería (Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas, Electrónica) o carrera técnica equivalente.
  • Idiomas: Dominio fluido de inglés y español.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conocimiento conceptual de software, modelos de despliegue (Cloud, SaaS, On-premise), APIs e integración. Familiaridad con los marcos de trabajo de la industria (ej. estándares TM Forum, eTOM, Open APIs). Entendimiento suficiente para influir técnicamente sin necesidad de ejecutar configuraciones profundas (hands-on).
  • Competencias: Comunicación técnica a nivel ejecutivo, capacidad para traducir problemas operativos en impacto de negocio, pensamiento estratégico a largo plazo y excelentes habilidades de negociación.
  • Disponibilidad: Para viajar atendiendo el territorio asignado.

Deseable

  • Experiencia previa y cartera de contactos en cuentas Tier-1 de la región.
  • Certificaciones en gestión de proyectos (PMP o similares) o Metodologías Agile.
  • Formación de posgrado en gestión tecnológica o negocios.

Qué Ofrecemos

  • Rol estratégico con impacto directo en el crecimiento de la compañía.
  • Trabajo con operadores de telecomunicaciones de primer nivel.
  • Participación en proyectos de automatización reales y de vanguardia.
  • Espacio para crecer profesionalmente combinando tecnología de alto nivel y negocio.

Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

title: Motion Graphics Video Editor
description:
Company Description

Holy Koolaid is a YouTube channel dedicated to science, skepticism, and critical thinking . The channel explores topics such as archaeology, religion, pseudoscience, cults, history, and misinformation. Our goal is to create engaging educational content that encourages curiosity and critical thinking .

Role Description

Holy Koolaid Media is looking for a highly skilled video editor with strong motion graphics experience to help produce fast-paced documentary and explainer videos for YouTube. Our content explores history, archaeology, science, and critical thinking , often examining religion, pseudoscience, and misinformation through a skeptical lens. We are looking for someone who can turn research-heavy scripts into compelling visual stories using animation, motion graphics, archival footage, and creative editing. This role requires someone who is detail-oriented, intellectually curious, and comfortable working with complex historical and scientific material . The position is fully remote , with occasional meetings in São Paulo preferred but not required .

What You'll Do

  • Edit long-form YouTube documentary and explainer videos
  • Create motion graphics and animations that help explain complex ideas
  • Cut footage to match script timing and narration
  • Add B-roll, archival footage, and visual references
  • Design and animate titles, diagrams, maps, and visual explanations
  • Add sound effects and polish audio
  • Work closely with the creator to ensure the visuals enhance the storytelling
  • Help research and locate visual assets relevant to historical and scientific topics
  • Maintain strong attention to detail to ensure accuracy and clarity

Required Skills

  • Strong experience with Adobe Premiere Pro (this is essential)
  • Experience with Photoshop
  • Experience creating motion graphics or animation
  • Ability to edit according to script timing and narrative pacing
  • Strong visual storytelling instincts
  • Extremely detail-oriented
  • Ability to research and find visual material when needed
  • At least 2 years of experience with motion graphics or animation
  • Ability to work independently and solve problems

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with After Effects
  • Some familiarity with Adobe Audition
  • Experience editing YouTube videos
  • Experience with documentary-style editing
  • Interest in history, archaeology, or science
  • Comfortable working on content that critically examines religion, pseudoscience, and misinformation
  • English proficiency at B1 level or higher (flexible if editing skills are exceptional)

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate:

  • Thinks like a storyteller, not just an editor
  • Can take complex ideas and make them visually understandable
  • Is comfortable learning new topics quickly
  • Is curious and enjoys researching historical and scientific subjects
  • Can work with fast-paced YouTube content
  • Has the resilience and independence to figure things out and solve problems

How to Apply

Please include:

  • Portfolio or demo reel
  • Examples of motion graphics or animation work
  • Examples of video editing projects
  • A short note explaining why you are interested in this role

Applicants without a portfolio or demo reel will not be considered.

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.

Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.

What You’ll Do

· Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

· Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

· Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

· Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

· Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

· Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

· Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap

Requirements (Must-Haves)

· Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

· 5+ years in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

· Solution engineering capability in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

· You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

· Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

· Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

· Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

· Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

· Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

· Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

· Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

· Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

· Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

· Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product

Location & Working Hours

· Brazil-based ( fully remote )

· Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET) working hours

What We Offer

· Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

· Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

· Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

· High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

· Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings

How to Apply

Submit your CV  in English , and  one paragraph describing how you would approach the  first 60 days after a new client’s go-live in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Application Engineer
description:
You'll join the AI Products squad to build the next generation of LLM-powered applications for the staffing industry. This is a product engineering role, not a research role. You'll ship real AI products used by real recruiters and real clients.

We're not looking for someone who trains models from scratch. We're looking for someone who knows how to build with LLMs — orchestrating agents, designing RAG pipelines, crafting prompt architectures, and shipping applications that solve real business problems. If you've built a chatbot, an agent, or a RAG app that actually went to production (or close to it), we want to talk.

What You'll Build

Example products in the pipeline

· AI Candidate Matching Engine — Match candidates to job openings using semantic search, skill extraction, and intelligent ranking.

· Intelligent Onboarding Agent — An agentic system that guides new hires through credentialing, document collection, compliance checks, and first-day preparation. Replaces manual follow-up chains.

· Recruiter Copilot — An AI assistant embedded in recruiters' daily workflow. Surfaces candidate suggestions, drafts outreach, summarizes conversations, and flags placement risks.

· Conversational BI — Natural language interface to business data. Users ask questions in plain English, get charts, tables, and insights back.

What You'll Do

· Design and build agentic systems — multi-step AI workflows that reason, retrieve, and act across multiple tools and data sources

· Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines — connect LLMs to company data through vector databases, semantic search, and context injection

· Craft prompt architectures — design system prompts, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought patterns, and guardrails for production LLM applications

· Integrate with APIs and data sources — consume data from our CDI platform (Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse), ATS (JobDiva), VMS platforms, and internal systems

· Ship production-grade applications — not prototypes. Build with error handling, monitoring, logging, fallback strategies, and user-facing quality

· Collaborate with the Data Platform squad — define what data you need in what format, and work with data engineers to make AI-ready datasets available

· Evaluate and iterate on AI quality — build evaluation frameworks, test edge cases, measure accuracy, and improve outputs systematically

· Stay current with the LLM ecosystem — new models, frameworks, and techniques ship weekly. You'll help evaluate what's worth adopting.

What We're Looking For

Must have (1-3 years of experience):

· Shipped at least one LLM-powered application in a real organization (not just personal projects or tutorials). This could be a chatbot, agent, RAG app, content generator, or similar.

· Strong Python skills — you think in Python, not just write it

· Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks — LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar

· Experience building RAG systems — vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS), embedding models, retrieval strategies, context window management

· Understanding of prompt engineering at a production level — not just getting good outputs, but building reliable, consistent, testable prompt architectures

· Familiarity with LLM APIs — OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or open-source model serving (Ollama, vLLM)

· Basic understanding of software engineering practices — Git, API design, error handling, logging

· Good communication in English (daily collaboration with a distributed team)

Nice to have:

· Experience with agent frameworks — multi-agent orchestration, tool use, function calling, planning loops

· Familiarity with fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning) — not required but valuable for future work

· Experience with evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs (RAGAS, custom metrics, human-in-the-loop evaluation)

· Knowledge of NLP fundamentals — text classification, NER, semantic similarity, embeddings

· Exposure to cloud deployment — Azure, AWS, or GCP for hosting AI services

· Familiarity with staffing, HR tech, or recruiting industry — understanding placement lifecycles, compliance, credentialing

· Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, or Azure ecosystem

Who You Are

· You graduated recently (1-3 years ago) and have already gotten your hands dirty building real AI applications in a real organization — internship, first job, startup, or contract work

· You're more of a builder than a researcher. You care about shipping products, not publishing papers.

· You're excited by the pace of LLM innovation and naturally stay up to date with new models, frameworks, and techniques

· You're comfortable with ambiguity. Some of these products don't have a playbook — you'll figure it out with the team.

· You're autonomous but collaborative. You can own a product end-to-end but also work closely with data engineers and product stakeholders.

Why This Role

· Build AI products at scale from day one. Our data infrastructure covers millions of candidates, Fortune 500 clients. The problems are real and the impact is immediate.

· Full product ownership. You won't be writing prompt templates in a vacuum. You'll own products end-to-end: architecture, data requirements, prompt design, API integration, quality, and iteration.

· Cutting-edge stack. LLMs, agents, RAG, vector databases, agentic workflows — all in production, not demos.

· Growth trajectory. As the team scales toward an AI Products Squad (2-3 engineers), early joiners will shape the team culture and grow into lead roles.

title: Internal Communication Specialist

About the Role

This role involves leading the internal communications strategy, creating high-quality content, and enhancing employee engagement through effective communication channels.

Responsibilities

Internal Communications & Content Strategy

  • Communications System Building: Lead the design, build-out, and continuous optimization of the company’s internal communications system to ensure efficient information flow and full-employee coverage.
  • Content Planning & Creation: Produce high-quality internal communications content (e.g., all-hands emails/letters, values stories, campaign copy) to convey the company’s values and strategic direction through high-quality writing.
  • Channel Management: Operate and optimize internal communication channels/platforms (e.g., intranet, official accounts/newsletters) to improve reach and employee engagement.
  • Culture Content Packaging: Translate corporate culture concepts into vivid, highly shareable formats (e.g., short-video scripts, visual posters/graphics) to strengthen employee awareness and alignment.
  • Employee Feedback & Insights: Collect employee feedback through surveys, interviews, and data analysis; diagnose communication pain points, propose improvement plans, and drive implementation.

Employer Branding & Influence

  • External Communications & Content Operations: Partner with HR, PR, Marketing and other teams to create and distribute content via platforms such as LinkedIn (e.g., news, culture, employee stories, recruiting content).
  • EVP Development: Conduct research to understand how external candidates and internal employees perceive Keeta; structure and refine Keeta’s Employee Value Proposition (EVP).
  • Content Strategy Iteration: Analyze channel/content performance data to generate insights and continuously optimize content strategy and operations.

Globalization & Localization

  • Cross-cultural Communication: Coordinate with global teams to ensure internal communications align with a unified company tone while adapting to local language and cultural norms.
  • Multilingual Content: Lead the creation of English and other language versions of internal content to support information alignment across multinational teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or above; 5+ years of experience in internal communications, corporate communications, content creation, marketing, or related fields. International/multinational experience and familiarity with multicultural communication scenarios are a plus.
  • English as a working language; able to write high-quality English content and collaborate effectively in meetings.
  • Strong writing versatility (e.g., formal corporate writing, in-depth interviews/features, social/new-media copy). Proven “viral/hit” content cases are a plus.
  • Strong desire to have your viewpoints and writing seen and remembered by millions—driven to shape how people understand a topic or a brand.
  • Smart, highly communicative, strong logical thinking and interpersonal sensitivity; able to quickly understand diverse businesses, cultures, and people through deep interviews and research, and design outstanding communication strategies.

Role Highlights

A unique opportunity to closely observe a company’s growth journey, cultural foundations, and management approach—and translate them into compelling stories that can be seen across the industry.

Pay range and compensation package

Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Keeta is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life.

We are seeking a Senior JDE Developer who is a true "Hybrid" professional—an expert coder who deeply understands the functional logic of Brazil Localization and Global Trade Compliance.

  • Functional Awareness: Ability to act as a "Technical-Functional Bridge," understanding the business process flow behind the technical specifications.

Key Responsibilities

  • System Integration: Maintain and optimize the "connectors" between JDE and external fiscal/trade applications to ensure 100% compliance.
  • Strategic Problem Solving: Provide Level 1–3 support with a focus on root-cause analysis and long-term architectural stability.
  • Collaborative Design: Partner with functional leads and business stakeholders to translate Brazilian regulatory changes into robust JDE solutions.

Languages & Education

  • Portuguese: Required (Native/Fluent).
  • English: Intermediate / Preferred. (We prioritize your technical-functional JDE expertise over absolute fluency).
  • Spanish: A significant plus (for collaboration across our LATAM footprint).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in IT/CS OR 10+ years of verifiable Senior JDE experience.

Apply with your CV in English.

description:

Keeta is the international arm of Meituan, one of the world’s largest delivery platforms. Our mission is bold: to revolutionize the delivery of food and everyday products across the globe. Our motto says it all: “We help people eat better, live better.”

With our Brazil launch approaching, we are expanding quickly and building a world-class team from the ground up. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy solving complex operational challenges, and want to make a visible impact, this could be the right opportunity for you.

We are looking for a Business Analytics Manager Logistics Optimization to support the design and continuous improvement of Keeta’s delivery dispatch system.   • Collaborate with product, engineering, and operations teams to implement and validate optimization initiatives
  • Support experimentation cycles to test new operational parameters and measure performance impact

What We’re Looking For ✅

  • Experience in marketplace platforms, logistics operations, ride-hailing, delivery services, or e-commerce environments
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using data to diagnose operational challenges and drive improvements
  • Proficiency with analytical tools such as SQL, Python, or BI platforms (Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
  • Ability to translate complex data into clear business insights and operational recommendations
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including product, engineering, and operations
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken

Why Join Us

  • Be part of building and scaling a new global delivery platform from the ground up
  • Work in a dynamic environment where analytical insights directly influence operational performance
  • Collaborate with talented teams across product, engineering, and operations
  • Join a culture that values ownership, innovation, and continuous learning

Ready to jump in?

description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

description:

title: Global HRBP
description:
About JD's International Business

We are committed to building a digitally intelligent cross-border supply chain and global retail infrastructure. Leveraging our global supply chain capabilities, JD continues to expand in markets where we possess distinct competitive advantages. Our diversified businesses—including retail, logistics, technology, industrial development, manufacturing, and healthcare—are growing in synergy. Currently, JD operates worldwide, with a presence in countries and regions such as China, the United States, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, France, Germany, Spain, Brazil, Hungary, Japan, South Korea, Australia, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE, serving customers across the globe.

Position Mission

As a core HR partner for our international expansion, you will be at the forefront of our rapidly growing global business. This is not just an HR role—it is a mission to become a "Growth Engine" and "Organizational Architect" for the business. We invest in your future through a unique 6-to-12-month immersive rotation program at our Beijing Headquarters. This program is designed to provide an in-depth understanding of our core business, culture, and operations, empowering you to drive organizational capability, build world-class teams, and ensure our people strategy accelerates our global growth.

Core Responsibilities

1. Global Talent Program: Beijing Headquarters Rotation (6–12 Months)

- Immerse yourself in the core operations, culture, and leadership network of our global business.

- Participate in structured training and mentorship while contributing to key projects in talent acquisition, organizational development, and HR analytics.

- Build a solid foundation and holistic perspective before transitioning to support international business teams.

2. Strategic HR Partnership & Business Insight

- Translate business strategies in international markets (e.g., Southeast Asia, Europe, North America, Middle East) into actionable people strategies.

- Provide forward-looking insights on organizational design, talent density, and cultural integration.

3. Talent Engine & Pipeline Development

- Lead end-to-end recruitment for critical roles in supply chain, warehouse management, cross-border logistics, and localized operations.

- Design and implement talent development initiatives such as the "Global Young Talent Program" to build a robust pipeline of future leaders.

4. Organizational Effectiveness & Team Activation

- Diagnose and optimize organizational structures and processes to enhance collaboration and performance in cross-cultural settings.

- Drive a results-oriented performance management system and leverage HR data to support business decision-making.

5. Global Culture & Employee Experience

- Champion JD’s corporate culture and foster an open, agile, and inclusive team environment across regions.

- Proactively manage employee relations and enhance the end-to-end employee lifecycle experience.

Qualifications & Attributes

We are seeking a future leader with business acumen, an entrepreneurial mindset, and high growth potential—not just a traditional HR practitioner.

Must-Haves

- Bachelor’s degree or above with at least 5 years of HR experience. Experience in internet, e-commerce, retail, logistics, or consulting is preferred.

- Global mindset: Overseas study/work experience or prior exposure to supporting international business is highly advantageous.

- Business acumen: Strong interest and ability to quickly grasp business logic, profitability models, and core challenges.

- Superior cognitive and problem-solving skills:

- Structured thinking: Ability to dissect complex situations and develop clear solution frameworks.

- Data-driven: Skilled in using data analysis to identify issues, validate hypotheses, and drive decisions.

- Drive & resilience:

- Ownership: Takes full responsibility for business challenges and outcomes.

- Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and views challenges as growth opportunities.

Core Competencies

- Excellent communication and influencing skills across all levels and cultures.

- A keen eye for identifying and developing high-potential talent.

- Collaborative team player.

What We Offer

Acreditamos que o agro muda o mundo. E você pode fazer parte dessa mudança!

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações Backend em Java (Java 11+);

  • Trabalhar com mensageria e integrações assíncronas;

  • Domínio da linguagem Java (11+);
  • Experiência avançada com Spring Boot, Spring Batch e Spring Data;
  • Vivência com arquitetura baseada em Microserviços, Clean Architecture e padrões de integração;
  • Experiência no design, documentação e versionamento de APIs REST;
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ ou similares);

description:

Se trata de una posición de implementación técnica, que demanda experiencia en entornos Linux, despliegues en infraestructura de cliente y capacidad para intervenir sobre configuraciones de sistemas y plataformas.

El rol es clave para garantizar que los productos desarrollados por Iquall se instalen, integren y operen correctamente en ambientes productivos.

Responsabilidades principales

  • Implementar técnicamente los productos desarrollados por Iquall en entornos de cliente.
  • Ejecutar la instalación, configuración y parametrización de nuestras soluciones.
  • Adaptar las implementaciones a la infraestructura específica del cliente (redes, seguridad, bases de datos, almacenamiento).
  • Administrar y configurar entornos Linux requeridos por la solución.
  • Implementar despliegues basados en contenedores y bare metal.
  • Participar en la puesta en producción y estabilización técnica post go-live.
  • Realizar troubleshooting avanzado durante implementación y operación inicial.
  • Validar la correcta integración con sistemas del cliente (OSS, BSS, APIs, sistemas de red, etc).
  • Documentar procedimientos técnicos y configuraciones específicas de cada proyecto.
  • Colaborar con equipos de Arquitectura, DevOps y Desarrollo ante requerimientos técnicos complejos.

Requisitos técnicos (excluyentes)

  • Experiencia sólida en administración avanzada de Linux.
  • Experiencia práctica trabajando con Kubernetes.
  • Experiencia implementando soluciones en entornos productivos.
  • Conocimientos de redes (TCP/IP, puertos, firewalling, conceptos básicos de routing).
  • Experiencia en análisis de logs y troubleshooting en servidores.
  • Conocimientos de instalación y configuración de bases de datos.
  • Comodidad trabajando principalmente desde línea de comandos.

Se valorará especialmente

  • Experiencia con Kubernetes.
  • Conocimientos en CI/CD.
  • Experiencia en automatización (bash, scripting).
  • Experiencia en proyectos de telecomunicaciones.
  • Conocimiento de entornos OSS/BSS.
  • Experiencia integrando sistemas vía APIs.
  • Experiencia en entornos cloud o virtualizados.

Perfil buscado

  • Fuerte orientación a resolución técnica.
  • Capacidad para trabajar en entornos de cliente con plazos definidos.
  • Autonomía técnica y criterio para tomar decisiones en implementación.
  • Capacidad para interactuar con equipos técnicos del cliente.
  • Mentalidad pragmática y foco en estabilidad y funcionamiento real de la solución.

Qué ofrecemos

  • Participación en proyectos técnicos desafiantes en el sector telecomunicaciones.
  • Trabajo con tecnologías modernas de automatización y despliegue.
  • Interacción directa con arquitectos y equipos de desarrollo.
  • Espacio para crecimiento técnico hacia roles de arquitectura o especialización en plataforma.

title: Quantity Surveyor
description:
Crewit Resourcing is hiring a Senior Quantity Surveyor

Location: Ireland

Contract: Permanent

Hours per week: Full time

We are looking for a Senior Quantity Surveyor manages project costs, budgets, procurement, contracts, variations, and financial reporting from project inception to completion.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead all pre‑contract and post‑contract cost management for structural steel projects.
  • Prepare detailed BOQs, cost plans, tender packages, and subcontract procurement schedules.
  • Manage valuations, applications for payment, variations, and change control.
  • Conduct cost‑to‑complete analysis and prepare monthly CVRs for senior management.
  • Work closely with fabrication, design, and project management teams to validate quantities, drawings, and project changes.
  • Negotiate subcontractor packages and manage subcontractor accounts through to final account settlement.
  • Analyse project risks, propose mitigation strategies, and maintain commercial risk registers.
  • Provide accurate cost reporting, forecasts, cash flow projections, and commercial advice across ongoing projects.
  • Ensure compliance with procedures, industry standards, and quality systems (ISO 9001 & 14001).
  • Mentor junior QS staff and support commercial team development.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years QS experience within structural steel, construction, or civils.
  • Strong measurement, estimating, and contract administration capability.
  • Proficiency in reading structural drawings, fabrication schedules, and steel detailing outputs.
  • Strong negotiation, analytical, and reporting skills.
  • Experience with JCT/NEC or similar contract forms.
  • Full clean driving licence; willingness to visit sites.
  • Willing to relocate

title: Especialista Desenvolvimento Protheus
description:
Quem nós somos?

Há 60 anos, a IHARA trabalha lado a lado do agricultor, desenvolvendo novas tecnologias que contribuem para proteger o potencial produtivo dos mais diversos cultivos.

Temos muito orgulho de estar neste solo, trabalhando constantemente para manter nossa agricultura entre as maiores do planeta.

Somos a IHARA porque assim escolhemos ser! Sonhamos grande. Acreditamos que a capacidade humana é ilimitada e nos desafiamos sempre.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES:

  • Desenvolver e manter soluções de software utilizando a linguagem de programação ADVPL TL++ no ambiente do sistema Protheus.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de negócios e administração para entender os requisitos do projeto e traduzi-los em soluções técnicas eficazes.
  • Participar ativamente do ciclo de vida completo do desenvolvimento de software, desde a concepção até a entrega e manutenção pós-implementação.
  • Realizar testes e depurações de código para garantir a qualidade e a integridade das soluções desenvolvidas.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria no código existente e propor soluções para otimizar a eficiência e o desempenho do sistema Protheus.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico e resolver problemas relacionados ao sistema Protheus, quando necessário.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as melhores práticas de programação e tendências tecnológicas relevantes para o ambiente Protheus.
  • Documentar soluções desenvolvidas e manter repositórios atualizados, garantindo a continuidade das operações ao realizar atualizações de sistemas (standard ou customizações).
  • Desenvolver webservices para consumo e disponibilização de dados do Protheus para outras aplicações e Data Lakes.
  • Desenvolver/configurar soluções no sistema ERP Protheus.
  • Analisar códigos e bugs no sistema ERP Protheus.
  • Desenvolver/configurar aplicações na plataforma Fluig para automação de processos.
  • Desenvolver e disponibilizar APIs para integrações e consumo de dados por outras aplicações.
  • Debugar soluções para identificar causa raiz de incidentes/bugs de aplicação e propor soluções que corrijam os erros.
  • Desenvolver soluções para correção de erros em customizações quando forem identificados incidentes.
  • Conduzir, junto aos fornecedores, o desenvolvimento de soluções integradas que garantam a continuidade do negócio.
  • Realizar o entendimento de integrações com outras aplicações e sistemas para garantir a solução mais adequada e que ofereça os benefícios requeridos pelas áreas solicitantes.
  • Documentar a especificação da solução e atualizar os repositórios para garantir a manutenção e evolução do sistema Protheus.
  • Analisar chamados e erros para identificar soluções.
  • Seguir processos e procedimentos de TI para realizar a promoção de atualizações no sistema.
  • Participar do desenvolvimento de planos de teste e garantir as condições para sua execução e validação.
  • Esclarecer dúvidas da equipe quanto ao funcionamento de soluções e do sistema Protheus, orientando quanto ao uso correto da ferramenta.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Protheus (TOTVS);
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Linguagem ADVPL / TL++;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Fluig;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Banco de Dados / APSDU;
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos na área.

PRINCIPAIS BENEFÍCIOS:

  • Assistência Médica;

  • Fretado;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Gympass;

  • Auxílio Material Escolar.

title: Senior Data Scientist (MDM)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist (MDM) to join global projects in master-data intelligence. In this role, you will own the end-to-end development of ML models that reconstruct business rules from SAP and non-SAP data and drive best practices that ensure our adaptive rule engines scale with the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and optimize PySpark-based ML pipelines that infer hidden business logic from millions of legacy records
  • Lead technical design reviews and establish MLOps standards for adaptive rule-discovery systems
  • Collaborate with data engineers, SAP functional leads, and business analysts to translate undocumented behaviors into validated, high-confidence business rules
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks, data-drift issues, and cross-platform inconsistencies in real-time inference jobs
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through pair programming, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions on large-scale feature engineering
  • Own release planning, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing strategies to maintain >95 % model-accuracy benchmarks

Need to Haves

  • 5+ years of production experience with PySpark, Databricks, and Azure cloud services
  • Proven track record of delivering scalable, high-performance ML solutions for pattern recognition and rule inference
  • Strong English skills—comfortable presenting model decisions to stakeholders and writing detailed RFCs
  • Demonstrated leadership in driving data-science excellence and mentoring teams

Nice to Haves

  • Deep domain expertise in master-data management (golden records, lineage, MDM quality frameworks)
  • Experience building and governing enterprise-grade ML feature stores or adaptive rule libraries
  • Proficiency with SAP MDG and understanding of SAP master-data structures
